- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. - dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

48	func (s *APIV1Service) dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx context.Context, memo *v1pb.Memo, activityType string) error {
49		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memo.Creator)
50		if err != nil {

52		}
53		if creator == nil {
54			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
55		}
56		creatorID := creator.ID
57		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, creatorID)
58		if err != nil {
59			return err
60		}
61		for _, hook := range webhooks {
62			payload, err := convertMemoToWebhookPayload(memo)
63			if err != nil {
64				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo to webhook payload")
65			}
66			payload.ActivityType = activityType
67			payload.URL = hook.Url
68			payload.SigningSecret = hook.SigningSecret
69	
70			// Use asynchronous webhook dispatch
71			webhook.PostAsync(payload)
72		}
73		return nil
74	}

86	// TestPostSignsRequest verifies the end-to-end Standard Webhooks signature so a
87	// receiver following the documented verification recipe will accept our requests.
88	func TestPostSignsRequest(t *testing.T) {
89		// httptest listens on 127.0.0.1, which the SSRF guard blocks by default.
90		prev := AllowPrivateIPs
91		AllowPrivateIPs = true
92		defer func() { AllowPrivateIPs = prev }()
93	
94		rawKey := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
95		cases := []struct {
96			name   string
97			secret string
98			key    []byte
99		}{
100			{name: "plain secret", secret: "plain-secret-value", key: []byte("plain-secret-value")},
101			{name: "whsec_ secret", secret: "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey), key: rawKey},
102		}
103	
104		for _, tc := range cases {
105			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
106				var gotID, gotTimestamp, gotSignature string
107				var gotBody []byte
108				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
109					gotID = r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
110					gotTimestamp = r.Header.Get("webhook-timestamp")
111					gotSignature = r.Header.Get("webhook-signature")
112					gotBody, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
113					_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
114				}))
115				defer server.Close()
116	
117				err := Post(&WebhookRequestPayload{
118					URL:           server.URL,
119					ActivityType:  "memos.memo.created",
120					Creator:       "users/1",
121					SigningSecret: tc.secret,
122				})
123				require.NoError(t, err)
124	
125				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotID, "msg_"), "webhook-id should be prefixed with msg_")
126				require.NotEmpty(t, gotTimestamp)
127				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotSignature, "v1,"), "signature should carry the v1 version tag")
128	
129				// Recompute the signature the way a receiver would and confirm it matches.
130				mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, tc.key)
131				mac.Write([]byte(gotID + "." + gotTimestamp + "."))
132				mac.Write(gotBody)
133				want := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
134				require.Equal(t, "v1,"+want, gotSignature)
135			})
136		}
137	}

37	// TestUserWebhookSigningSecretLifecycle covers the reveal-later flow: a webhook
38	// created without a secret is auto-assigned one server-side (exposed only via the
39	// signing_secret_set flag), the owner can reveal the value, and a non-owner cannot.
40	func TestUserWebhookSigningSecretLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
41		svc := newIntegrationService(t)
42		ctx := context.Background()
43	
44		// First user initializes the store as host/admin; the test actors are regular users.
45		_, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "host", Role: store.RoleAdmin, Email: "host@example.com"})
46		require.NoError(t, err)
47		owner, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "owner", Role: store.RoleUser, Email: "owner@example.com"})
48		require.NoError(t, err)
49		other, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "other", Role: store.RoleUser, Email: "other@example.com"})
50		require.NoError(t, err)
51	
52		ownerCtx := userCtx(ctx, owner.ID)
53		otherCtx := userCtx(ctx, other.ID)
54	
55		// Create without supplying a secret -> the server generates one.
56		created, err := svc.CreateUserWebhook(ownerCtx, &v1pb.CreateUserWebhookRequest{
57			Parent:  "users/owner",
58			Webhook: &v1pb.UserWebhook{DisplayName: "deploy", Url: "https://example.com/postreceive"},
59		})
60		require.NoError(t, err)
61		require.True(t, created.SigningSecretSet, "create must auto-generate a signing secret")
62		require.Empty(t, created.SigningSecret, "create response must never carry the secret value")
63	
64		// The owner can reveal the generated value.
65		revealed, err := svc.GetUserWebhookSigningSecret(ownerCtx, &v1pb.GetUserWebhookSigningSecretRequest{Name: created.Name})
66		require.NoError(t, err)
67		require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(revealed.SigningSecret, "whsec_"), "revealed secret must be in whsec_ form")

70		_, err = svc.GetUserWebhookSigningSecret(otherCtx, &v1pb.GetUserWebhookSigningSecretRequest{Name: created.Name})
71		require.Error(t, err)
72		require.Equal(t, codes.PermissionDenied, status.Code(err), "non-owner must be denied")

48	func (s *APIV1Service) dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx context.Context, memo *v1pb.Memo, activityType string) error {
49		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memo.Creator)
50		if err != nil {
51			return status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
52		}
53		if creator == nil {
54			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
55		}
56		creatorID := creator.ID
57		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, creatorID)
58		if err != nil {
59			return err
60		}
61		for _, hook := range webhooks {
62			payload, err := convertMemoToWebhookPayload(memo)
63			if err != nil {
64				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo to webhook payload")
65			}
66			payload.ActivityType = activityType
67			payload.URL = hook.Url
68			payload.SigningSecret = hook.SigningSecret
69	
70			// Use asynchronous webhook dispatch
71			webhook.PostAsync(payload)
72		}
73		return nil
74	}

86	// TestPostSignsRequest verifies the end-to-end Standard Webhooks signature so a
87	// receiver following the documented verification recipe will accept our requests.
88	func TestPostSignsRequest(t *testing.T) {
89		// httptest listens on 127.0.0.1, which the SSRF guard blocks by default.
90		prev := AllowPrivateIPs
91		AllowPrivateIPs = true
92		defer func() { AllowPrivateIPs = prev }()
93	
94		rawKey := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
95		cases := []struct {
96			name   string
97			secret string
98			key    []byte
99		}{
100			{name: "plain secret", secret: "plain-secret-value", key: []byte("plain-secret-value")},
101			{name: "whsec_ secret", secret: "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey), key: rawKey},
102		}
103	
104		for _, tc := range cases {
105			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
106				var gotID, gotTimestamp, gotSignature string
107				var gotBody []byte
108				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
109					gotID = r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
110					gotTimestamp = r.Header.Get("webhook-timestamp")
111					gotSignature = r.Header.Get("webhook-signature")
112					gotBody, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
113					_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
114				}))
115				defer server.Close()
116	
117				err := Post(&WebhookRequestPayload{
118					URL:           server.URL,
119					ActivityType:  "memos.memo.created",
120					Creator:       "users/1",
121					SigningSecret: tc.secret,
122				})
123				require.NoError(t, err)
124	
125				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotID, "msg_"), "webhook-id should be prefixed with msg_")
126				require.NotEmpty(t, gotTimestamp)
127				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotSignature, "v1,"), "signature should carry the v1 version tag")
128	
129				// Recompute the signature the way a receiver would and confirm it matches.
130				mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, tc.key)
131				mac.Write([]byte(gotID + "." + gotTimestamp + "."))
132				mac.Write(gotBody)
133				want := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
134				require.Equal(t, "v1,"+want, gotSignature)
135			})
136		}
137	}

37	// TestUserWebhookSigningSecretLifecycle covers the reveal-later flow: a webhook
38	// created without a secret is auto-assigned one server-side (exposed only via the
39	// signing_secret_set flag), the owner can reveal the value, and a non-owner cannot.
40	func TestUserWebhookSigningSecretLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
41		svc := newIntegrationService(t)
42		ctx := context.Background()
43	
44		// First user initializes the store as host/admin; the test actors are regular users.
45		_, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "host", Role: store.RoleAdmin, Email: "host@example.com"})
46		require.NoError(t, err)
47		owner, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "owner", Role: store.RoleUser, Email: "owner@example.com"})
48		require.NoError(t, err)
49		other, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "other", Role: store.RoleUser, Email: "other@example.com"})
50		require.NoError(t, err)
51	
52		ownerCtx := userCtx(ctx, owner.ID)
53		otherCtx := userCtx(ctx, other.ID)
54	
55		// Create without supplying a secret -> the server generates one.
56		created, err := svc.CreateUserWebhook(ownerCtx, &v1pb.CreateUserWebhookRequest{
57			Parent:  "users/owner",
58			Webhook: &v1pb.UserWebhook{DisplayName: "deploy", Url: "https://example.com/postreceive"},
59		})
60		require.NoError(t, err)
61		require.True(t, created.SigningSecretSet, "create must auto-generate a signing secret")
62		require.Empty(t, created.SigningSecret, "create response must never carry the secret value")
63	
64		// The owner can reveal the generated value.
65		revealed, err := svc.GetUserWebhookSigningSecret(ownerCtx, &v1pb.GetUserWebhookSigningSecretRequest{Name: created.Name})
66		require.NoError(t, err)
67		require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(revealed.SigningSecret, "whsec_"), "revealed secret must be in whsec_ form")

70		_, err = svc.GetUserWebhookSigningSecret(otherCtx, &v1pb.GetUserWebhookSigningSecretRequest{Name: created.Name})
71		require.Error(t, err)
72		require.Equal(t, codes.PermissionDenied, status.Code(err), "non-owner must be denied")
